case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the hotel's central location and working air conditioning, and several found rooms comfortable or spacious. Negative comments include nighttime noise and poor soundproofing, inconsistent or absent staff and disputes over room allocation/refunds and late check-in charges, aging or broken facilities (fridge, windows, missing kitchen appliances), mixed cleanliness reports for shared bathrooms, and some small or stuffy rooms.

priorities.recommendation: Verify cleanliness and ensure consumables, increase inspections, inspect 2nd-floor shower drainage, escalate issues, inform guests.

priorities.area: Staff communication, booking accuracy and late check-in/fees transparency
priorities.recommendation: Review front-desk procedures, audit bookings, reinforce communication training, update booking text, revise policies if ambiguous.
Implement operational mitigations, inspect windows/doors, prioritize quiet placements where possible, and document noise at booking.
Ensure 24/7 or extended front-desk/on-call coverage, inspect doors/windows, communicate hours, and define emergency contact/response targets.
Implement short customer-service complaint-handling refund-policy training; standardize procedures/postings, add escalation-log, review disputes weekly until resolved.
Conduct urgent inventory, check all appliances; prioritize flagged repairs, log completion, prepare capital-plan and guest-timeline.
